MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 我叫 wǒ jiào mean when it comes before a name? (1 mark)
   A. Where is
   B. I like
   C. I am going to
   D. My name is

2. What does 昨天 (zuótiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. Mosque
   C. Week (short form)
   D. To go

3. What does 星期 xīngqī mean? (1 mark)
   A. Year
   B. Day
   C. Week
   D. Month

4. What does 今天星期几? jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? ask? (1 mark)
   A. What day of the week is it today?
   B. What is your name?
   C. How many people are there?
   D. Where is school?

5. Which Chinese word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 礼物 lǐwù
   B. 切 qiē
   C. 大家 dàjiā
   D. 我们 wǒmen

6. What does 葡萄 (pútao) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. Cooked rice
   C. Grapes
   D. Snacks

7. Which verb goes with 茶? (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 喝
   C. 去
   D. 吃

8. Which Chinese word means "what"? (1 mark)
   A. 葡萄 pútao
   B. 什么 shénme
   C. 水 shuǐ
   D. 肉 ròu

9. What does 眼睛看 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The mouth speaks
   B. The ears hear
   C. The eyes see
   D. The hands write

10. What does the broken telephone game teach? (1 mark)
   A. Careful listening
   B. Drawing
   C. Counting
   D. Fast running

11. What does 洪水 (hóngshuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flood
   B. Not
   C. Also
   D. Very

12. Fill the blank: 太阳____大。 (The sun is very big.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 很
   C. 有
   D. 是

13. Which weather word means "cloud"? (1 mark)
   A. 风 fēng
   B. 云 yún
   C. 雪 xuě
   D. 雨 yǔ

14. What does 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. I, me
   C. Good morning
   D. Goodbye

15. Which sentence means "Goodbye!"? (1 mark)
   A. 你呢?
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 谢谢!
   D. 再见!

16. Which Chinese word means "love"? (1 mark)
   A. 谁 shéi
   B. 爱 ài
   C. 姐姐 jiějie
   D. 有 yǒu

17. What does 爱 (ài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Younger brother
   C. Mother
   D. Is, am, are

18. Which word is pronounced xīngqītiān? (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 七
   C. 星期天
   D. 学校

19. What does 几 (jǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. Which number, how many
   C. Everybody
   D. Gift

20. What does 生日 (shēngrì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To come
   B. Happy
   C. Birthday
   D. Cake

21. What does 喜欢 (xǐhuan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Dinner
   C. Apple
   D. To like

22. What does 不 bù mean in 我不喜欢咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. And
   B. Not
   C. Also
   D. Very

23. Read the pinyin: zhè shì tàiyáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rain is heavy.
   B. This is the sun.
   C. Today there are clouds.
   D. The wind is very strong.

24. Which character means "big"? (1 mark)
   A. 大
   B. 天
   C. 太
   D. 人

25. How many strokes does 妈 have? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 6

26. What does 妈妈 (māma) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Mother
   C. Younger brother
   D. Father

27. Which sentence means "That is my younger brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 我家有五口人。
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 那是我弟弟。
   D. 这是我爸爸。

28. Which sentence is correct for "The chair is under the table"? (1 mark)
   A. 桌子在椅子下。
   B. 椅子下在桌子。
   C. 在椅子桌子下。
   D. 椅子在桌子下。

29. Which Chinese word means "bed"? (1 mark)
   A. 下面 xiàmiàn
   B. 床 chuáng
   C. 放 fàng
   D. 椅子 yǐzi

30. Which Chinese word means "Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 周 zhōu
   B. 四 sì
   C. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   D. 星期三 xīngqīsān

31. Which order does a sentence about the week use? (1 mark)
   A. who + when + what
   B. when + what + who
   C. what + who + when
   D. what + when + who

32. Which Chinese word means "four"? (1 mark)
   A. 十 shí
   B. 四 sì
   C. 一 yī
   D. 九 jiǔ

33. Which sentence means "We sing."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们唱歌。
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 我们切蛋糕。
   D. 祝你生日快乐!

34. What does 什么 (shénme) mean? (1 mark)
   A. What
   B. Meat
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Snacks

35. Read the pinyin: jīntiān yǒu yún. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rain is heavy.
   B. Today there are clouds.
   C. The sun is very big.
   D. The weather is very good today.

36. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn xiǎo. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is very light.
   B. The rain is heavy.
   C. Today there are clouds.
   D. The sun is very big.

37. What does 错 cuò mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Rain
   B. Right
   C. Today
   D. Wrong

38. Which stroke is written first in 右? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 横 héng
   C. 点 diǎn
   D. 竖 shù

39. Fill the blank: 花园在房子____。 (The garden is on the right of the house.) (1 mark)
   A. 左边
   B. 里
   C. 下面
   D. 右边

40. What does 右边 (yòubian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Things
   B. Right side
   C. Kitchen
   D. Television

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final. (3 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is on the table." (3 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 七 and 云. (2 marks)

44. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table." (4 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" (3 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?" (2 marks)

47. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 前面. (2 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 看. (2 marks)

49. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng. (2 marks)

50. Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them. (4 marks)

51. Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin. (4 marks)

52. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today there are clouds." (2 marks)

53. Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below. (3 marks)

54. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello! (polite)" (2 marks)

55. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 九 and 号. (2 marks)

56. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 下雨 and 耳朵. (2 marks)

57. Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday. (3 marks)

58. Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我. (3 marks)

59. Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points. (5 marks)

60. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

61. Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head." (2 marks)

62. Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — My name is
   叫 means to be called, so 我叫 introduces your name.

2. A — Yesterday
   昨天 (zuótiān) means yesterday.

3. C — Week
   星期 followed by a number makes the day names.

4. A — What day of the week is it today?
   几 asks which number, so 星期几 asks which day of the week.

5. A — 礼物 lǐwù
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

6. C — Grapes
   葡萄 (pútao) means grapes.

7. B — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

8. B — 什么 shénme
   什么 (shénme) means what.

9. C — The eyes see
   眼睛 is eyes and 看 is to see.

10. A — Careful listening
   A whispered word can change when a listener misses a sound or tone.

11. A — Flood
   洪水 (hóngshuǐ) means flood.

12. B — 很
   很 means very and goes before 大.

13. B — 云 yún
   云 is a cloud.

14. C — Good morning
   早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) means good morning.

15. D — 再见!
   再见! (zàijiàn!) means "Goodbye!".

16. B — 爱 ài
   爱 (ài) means love.

17. A — Love
   爱 (ài) means love.

18. C — 星期天
   星期天 is pronounced xīngqītiān and means Sunday.

19. B — Which number, how many
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

20. C — Birthday
   生日 (shēngrì) means birthday.

21. D — To like
   喜欢 (xǐhuan) means to like.

22. B — Not
   不 is not.

23. B — This is the sun.
   zhè shì tàiyáng. is 这是太阳。, which means "This is the sun.".

24. A — 大
   大 dà is big.

25. D — 6
   女 has 3 strokes and 马 has 3.

26. B — Mother
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

27. C — 那是我弟弟。
   那是我弟弟。 (nà shì wǒ dìdi.) means "That is my younger brother.".

28. D — 椅子在桌子下。
   thing + 在 + place + 下.

29. B — 床 chuáng
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

30. D — 星期三 xīngqīsān
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

31. A — who + when + what
   我 + 星期三 + 去学校.

32. B — 四 sì
   四 (sì) means four.

33. A — 我们唱歌。
   我们唱歌。 (wǒmen chànggē.) means "We sing.".

34. A — What
   什么 (shénme) means what.

35. B — Today there are clouds.
   jīntiān yǒu yún. is 今天有云。, which means "Today there are clouds.".

36. A — The wind is very light.
   fēng hěn xiǎo. is 风很小。, which means "The wind is very light.".

37. D — Wrong
   错 is wrong; 对 is right.

38. A — 撇 piě
   右 begins with the falling stroke.

39. D — 右边
   右边 is the right side.

40. B — Right side
   右边 (yòubian) means right side.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 七: qī, seven. 云: yún, cloud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 看: kàn, to look, to see.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for b, 1 mark for p, 1 mark for another pair, 1 mark for the paper test or description.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天有云。 jīntiān yǒu yún.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 九: jiǔ, nine. 号: hào, date (day of the month).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 下雨: xià yǔ, it rains. 耳朵: ěrduo, ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

59. (5 marks)
   Answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.
